title: Uncommitted work thrown away by a git command
summary: A steady run of bug reports describes the same loss: while fixing or rolling something back, the agent ran a git command that resets the working tree, and hours or days of uncommitted work disappeared. Work that was never committed cannot be brought back from git history.
lesson: Commit before you let an agent work, and make the discarding git commands ask first.

sources.title: Issue 16098: reverted uncommitted work while debugging
Issue 33850: two days of uncommitted work destroyed

scenarios.note: An option before the subcommand gets past a rule written for git reset.
